SELECT r.reservation_code AS reservationCode, r.class_code AS classCode, r.member_code AS memberCode, r.schedule_code AS scheduleCode, r.reservation_date AS reservationDate, r.people_number AS peopleNum, r.status AS status, c.price AS price, c.name AS className, cr.activity_name AS activityName, img.image AS classImg FROM reservation r JOIN class c ON r.class_code = c.class_code LEFT JOIN creator cr ON c.operator_code = cr.operator_code LEFT JOIN class_img img ON c.class_code = img.class_code AND img.type = '대표' AND img.sort_order = 1
WHERE r.reservation_code = #{reservationCode}
